symptom: The untrusted reference reconciliation checked the candidate and reference shapes on caller-owned objects, then directly reread candidate formula digests and manifest fields after further descriptor traversal. A late descriptor Proxy could repair an initially mismatching candidate formula digest or manifest evidence stage before content comparison, yielding referencesReconciled=true for a different claim. Independent authority and scoring remained denied.
lesson: Strict descriptor-only shape checks are not snapshots: a later descriptor trap can repair an earlier untrusted formula or manifest field before direct reads, causing reference equality to describe a different state.
guardrail: Before any reference-reconciliation semantic validation, copy the complete candidate and reference graphs using the shared bounded own-data-descriptor snapshot, and validate/hash/compare only detached values. Negative regressions must prove that late candidate-digest and nested manifest-stage mutations execute but do not produce reconciliation. Keep scoringAuthorized=false; matching digests never establish independent source authority.
